identity_policy: prior element id -> players_raw.code -> current stable player code
selection_policy: minimize log_loss + minutes_mae/90 on players averaging >=30 minutes over their prior three matches; predict 2025/26 GW1-38 from only older rows

benchmark_current_empirical.population: same contender rule, GW6-38, players with >=2 current rows

known_limits: club-change retention and offseason gap are explicit assumptions, not fitted
one historical season cannot test season-to-season transport
